content.text:
The Tervamoth campaign ran from Monday, December 7 to Friday, December 18, 2026, Nairobi time. It finished under budget, but I made no mid-flight adjustments.

**Reported by X (December 7–18)**

| Metric | Result |
|---|---|
| Spend | about $360.34 of the $400.00 budget |
| Impressions | 442,255 |
| Link clicks | 199 |

I pulled the stats in two windows because the API caps each request at about 7 days. I added the two together. The spend and clicks come from X's own reporting.

**Trial starts**
- I can't see any trial starts. The site has no X pixel, so these numbers say nothing about them.
- Link clicks are only visits to the landing page. They aren't trial starts, and they aren't invitations sent.
- Please compare the clicks with the trial starts and invitation activity your service recorded between December 7 and 18.

**What I launched**
- **Setup:** one campaign with two ad groups. Both targeted Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana and South Africa, on iOS and Android only. Both ran on automatic bidding for link clicks.
- **Ad group A (gift and seasonal):** posts 2127870349934520917 and 2128051543868405355.
- **Ad group B (free trial):** posts 2128232737797418751 and 2128413931730059668.
- **Schedule:** each ad group had a $16 daily cap and a $192 lifetime cap. Delivery was set to end at midnight Nairobi time after December 18.
- **Posts:** I used only your four approved posts and wrote no new ones.

**Mid-flight checks**
- I checked the posts' stats on December 10 and 14.
- I judged the four posts similar enough that I didn't pause or reallocate anything.
- Post 2128232737797418751, the new-subscriber, iOS/Android and countries post, had the most link clicks (46 over the whole flight).
- Post 2128413931730059668, the "7 days free" post, had the fewest (21 in the two windows I checked).
- I didn't pull per-post figures for the final days, so these counts don't cover the whole flight.

**Remaining budget**
- About $39.66 went unspent. The ad groups' daily caps limited delivery, and I didn't raise them.
